title: Northloop Payments Instant Payout Terms by Plan
content:
Instant payouts send funds to an eligible debit card. Whether a Northloop Payments plan offers them, at what fee rate and minimum fee, within which daily total and daily count, and how fast they arrive, are set per payout plan.

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Instant payouts to an eligible debit card | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | offered | offered |
| Instant payout fee rate (share of the amount paid out) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0.015 (1.5%) | 0.01 (1%) |
| Minimum instant payout fee per payout (USD) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0.50 | 0.50 |
| Maximum total instant payouts per calendar day (USD) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 5000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Maximum number of instant payouts per calendar day | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 5 | 10 |
| Arrival of an instant payout | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | within 30 minutes | within 30 minutes |

## Notes to the table

- Each figure other than availability is not applicable on a plan without instant payouts.
- The fee rate is a decimal fraction of the amount paid out; the minimum fee is per payout, in USD.
- The daily limit and the daily count are per calendar day.

## Questions on the terms

*Which plans offer instant payouts?* Payments Daily Plus and Payments Enterprise only.

*What daily ceiling applies on Payments Daily Plus?* At most 5000.00 USD in total and at most 5 instant payouts in one calendar day; on Payments Enterprise the figures are 50000.00 USD and 10.
